name: @khorsheed/dsh-eval
description: The web-eval orchestrator: dataseek contract schemas, plan/condition validation, deterministic hashing, run-template generation from a suite manifest, the stage-one/two run loop (per-cell materialization, byte-exact delegation, submit/transition, judging, archive gate, bundle export), the two mechanical verdict sources (verify-layer probes writing script, de-fingerprinted double-sampled blind LLM judging writing llm-draft), and the bundle report (results.jsonl + summary.md behind the four-invariant gate)

compat.notes: injects commands (the /eval slash face); the run verb probes datasets / mission / localAgent via ctx.get and refuses naming any missing one — never a boot failure; report only reads bundles and consumes no host capability; the delegation cwd option and the usage / model.observed read-back (settled event, else delegationOf) are consumed from the local-agent family (T11) — against a facade predating it the cwd option is ignored (the cell is then refused honestly, never mis-attributed) and the read-back is recorded as null — judge (T9): probes and blind LLM judging run through the same faces; a judge sample without cwd support is recorded as a parse failure, never a verdict; the four read-only model tools and the tool:eval prompt section are NOT registered by this package any more — the companion `@khorsheed/dsh-eval-tool` owns them, and an agent preset grants the row per session (`tools`: all / none on that row; `none` and a missing row both leave the model without them, while this core's service, CLI, and /eval slash face stay mounted); the container path (T20) additionally probes lab via ctx.get — only a plan declaring a `unit` segment needs it, and its absence is a refusal naming it rather than a silent fallback to the host path; a lab predating AcquireSpec.ownWorkdir ignores the field, and a unit whose declared user cannot write its own workdir then fails at the first write from inside it, which is a loud failure rather than a wrong result; the environment class is derived through lab's `fingerprintOf`, so a lab predating that verb makes the container path refuse rather than hash by a second rule; the register-layout judging directory needs the descriptor `datasets.show` returns, and a facade that reports none degrades to the convention layout; the container path mounts the harness's own scoped home through the facade's `homeDir(harness)`, so a facade predating that method makes the container path refuse rather than mount some other directory — mounting a copy leaves the delegation read-back permanently empty with no error at all
